# Almedia Link — Almedia Launchpad

> Almedia Link is a Unity SDK (package `com.almedia.sdk`, current version 1.3.2) that adds a rewarded account-linking flow to mobile games. Players link a Freecash account from inside the game and earn real cash, gift cards or in-game currency for progress they were already making. Almedia funds those rewards; they do not come out of the publisher's economy. Publishers are paid a CPA for every verified link. Across live integrations the SDK sees an average 15% install-to-link rate and a 10%+ LTV lift for linked players.

## SDK repository

https://github.com/almedia-tm/almedia-sdk

Documentation lives in `Documentation~/`: `integration-guide.md`, `api-reference.md`,
`testing.md`, `migration-guide.md`.

## Agent integration path

> A coding agent can complete an Almedia Link integration from two inputs: (1) the SDK repository at https://github.com/almedia-tm/almedia-sdk — read `README.md` and `Documentation~/integration-guide.md` — and (2) an iOS and an Android integration key, issued by the publisher's Almedia account manager. No other context is required. Keys are set in Unity under Almedia > Settings, or passed as `AlmediaConfig.IosIntegrationKey` and `AlmediaConfig.AndroidIntegrationKey`. The technical pages on this site are placeholders; the repository is the source of truth for all SDK detail.

## Requirements

- Unity 2022.3 LTS or newer
- iOS 13.0 or newer
- Android API 23 or newer
- TextMeshPro 3.0.6 (declared as a package dependency)

## Key types

- `Almedia` — static facade; entry point for every SDK operation (`Initialize`, `ShowLink`, `Status`, and the events below)
- `AlmediaConfig` — configuration object passed to `Almedia.Initialize`
- `AlmediaStatus` — the player's current state. A type hierarchy, not a flat enum: `Eligible`, `Linked`, `NotAvailable(reason)`, `Blocked`, `Disabled`, matched with C# pattern matching
- `AlmediaErrorCode` — error codes reported through `OnErrorOccurred`, including `LinkingFailed` and `InvalidConfiguration`
- `AlmediaProgress`, `AlmediaRewardPoints`, `AlmediaMoney` — the progress snapshot and its reward values
- `AlmediaScreen`, `AlmediaInAppScreenResult` — in-app screen lifecycle
- `AlmediaEditorMock` — editor-only test hook (`AlmediaSDK.Editor.Testing`) for driving non-happy paths without a device build

## Key events

- `OnStatusChanged` — fires for both fresh links and already-linked sessions
- `OnLinkCompleted(linkedAt)` — fires only for a link completed during the current session
- `OnErrorOccurred`, `OnProgressUpdated`, `OnNotificationsReceived`, `OnInGameRewardGrantRequested`
- `OnScreenPresented` / `OnScreenDismissed` — pause and resume the game around in-app screens

## Attribution

Almedia reads the publisher's existing MMP data to score linked players. Adjust, AppsFlyer and
Singular are supported. **Unattributed postbacks are required** — events must be sent for all
media sources including organic, not only for players Almedia attributed. Missing unattributed
data is the most common cause of an integration that looks correct but rewards nothing.
